scrape_boards.info.empty: temp/jobs.csv is empty -- run a scrape.

scrape_jobs.info.empty: temp/jobs.csv is empty -- scrape the boards first.

analysis.title: AI analysis

cv.help.min_grade: Postings graded below this are not worth a tailored CV, so they stay out of the list.
cv.caption.select_generate: Best fit first. Select one, then generate.
cv.caption.budget: One Sonnet call: budget around half a minute.
cv.button.generate_disabled: Generate a CV (select a posting first)
cv.caption.newest_first: Newest first. Select one to read it.
cv.info.select_cv: Select a CV above to read it.
